name: Camp Metacomet
description_short: YMCA Southcoast summer day camp on 58 acres in Dartmouth, MA, open weekdays 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM with an outdoor pool. Activities include archery, sports, rock climbing, arts and crafts and swimming, plus specialty weeks for ages 9-14.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp has an outdoor pool; swimming is one of the traditional activities.
